key_insight: Expert Behavior Prior RL learns expert-like action priors from the online replay buffer, improving exploration, stability, and sample efficiency without needing offline expert trajectories.
engineering_relevance: This is relevant for autonomous robotics and industrial control because it offers a more practical way to stabilize online RL when high-quality demonstration data is limited or unavailable.
method: Q-CVAE generates high-value expert policy priors from the online replay buffer.
Expert Policy Guidance (EPG) selects actions from a generative support set to strengthen policy exploitation.
Policy Gradient Correction (PGC) aligns Q-guidance with expert supervision for stable updates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive benchmarks on Gym, PyBullet, and DMControl, where EBP outperforms state-of-the-art online RL methods with better sample efficiency and more stable convergence.
watch_item: Performance may depend on accurate Q-guidance and well-tuned generative support, so instability or bias in value estimates could affect action prior quality.
